title: Incompressible Euler Blowup at the $C^{1,\frac{1}{3}}$ Threshold
summary: We prove finite-time Type--I blowup for the three-dimensional incompressible Euler equations in the axisymmetric no-swirl class, with initial velocity in $C^{1,α}(\mathbb{R}^3)\cap L^2(\mathbb{R}^3)$, odd symmetry in $z$, and $0<α<\tfrac13$, for an explicit class of finite-energy initial data. The singularity forms at a stagnation point on the symmetry axis.
